info.title: POST PULSAR Local Control API
info.description: Authoritative loopback-only post-pulsar.control/v1 contract. Unknown fields are rejected. No operation accepts filesystem paths, SQL, shell text, platform credentials, media bytes, or platform response bodies.

post.description: Requires the agent bearer capability. Any bearer holder (agent or operator) may request graceful shutdown; the principal header alone grants no authority and an operator secret is not required. The startup_nonce must exactly match the discovered endpoint incarnation. This operation is independent of publication permission and uses the nonce instead of If-Match or Idempotency-Key. Acceptance means stopping has been requested, not that shutdown has completed.

202.description: Authenticated shutdown accepted for the exact daemon incarnation.

409.description: Stale startup nonce, incompatible control version, or shutdown is unavailable.

get.description: Authenticated installation/incarnation handshake. Compare installation_id, pid, process_started_at, startup_nonce and every discovery path with the opened bootstrap and endpoint records before accepting the service. Discovery paths are private bridge metadata and must be removed from agent/tool output. No credential values are returned.

200.description: Capabilities bound to the running daemon and configured discovery files.

409.description: The application has no bound daemon incarnation.

post.description: Creating enabled or already-due work requires an approved intent; disabled future schedules do not.

patch.description: Modification requires approval when the stored schedule is enabled, the result is enabled, or due work exists.

post.description: Operator-origin intent creation; requires both local credentials and is independent of agent publication opt-in.
Operator-only. Requires both the agent bearer and X-Post-Pulsar-Operator-Secret; the latter is accepted nowhere else.

DiscoveryPaths.description: Canonical absolute configured paths on the daemon host. All three paths must be distinct. These locations are handshake metadata, never tool arguments or host-facing output.

EndpointRecord.description: Closed non-secret endpoint discovery record written by the daemon. Identity and discovery values must exactly match the authenticated capabilities response.

Write.description: Base profile write fields. Each operation narrows arguments to its exact schema.

Accepted.description: Durable request accepted; no platform call occurred in the HTTP thread.

x-control-constraints.agent_publish_policy: Agent confirmation creation and consumption for publication-enabling actions require installation allow_agent_publish=true. Operator-origin approval remains separately authenticated.
